statement: Pinned xpad's real USB Xbox One path requires the Xbox GIP data interface, has model-conditional initialization (including an Xbox One S step), and decodes separate Guide events and GIP input packets. Reproducing its post-driver evdev shape through uinput does not implement USB GIP, genuine interface enumeration, startup exchanges or headset traffic.

applicability.revision: stock Microsoft Xbox One USB driver path, explicitly not a virtual GIP emulation claim
applicability.scope: xpad.c:642-659, 725-733, 1052-1160, 2056-2132; last sentence is a boundary of the derived uinput surface, not a physical measurement.
